title: Monthly atmospheric CO2
description: Monthly mean atmospheric carbon dioxide at Mauna Loa Observatory (1958 to present) and the global marine-surface average (1979 to present), with the seasonal-cycle-removed trend.

source.name: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide
source.attribution: Lan, X., Tans, P. and K.W. Thoning: Trends in globally-averaged CO2 determined from NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory measurements. NOAA GML (https://gml.noaa.gov/ccgg/trends/). Mauna Loa data from March 1958 to April 1974 obtained by C. David Keeling, Scripps Institution of Oceanography.

series.trend: Monthly mean with the average seasonal cycle removed
